notes: Calls are semi-annual (PhillipCapital hosted). No Q3 FY26 call was held, per management on the 15 May 2026 call. The 8 events are the last 8 calls.
H2 FY24 (15 May 2024) and H1 FY24 (Nov 2023) exist per Screener and Trendlyne, but no transcript could be opened after 2 attempts each. Marked not_retrieved.

Graded events: H1 FY26, H2 FY25, H1 FY25, H2 FY23, H1 FY23. Recency weights are 5/4/3/2/1. Q4 FY26 is pending: the call is too recent, and its only matured promise (Q1 FY27 exports) is graded 0 at promise level but excluded from the score.
Rule 7 origin-tracing for calls before Oct 2022 (Dec 2021, Apr 2022) was not run. No outside_window entries.

FY26 revenue has two bases. Company headline: ₹396.0 cr total revenue incl. other income of ₹11.2 cr (+7.4% vs ₹368.8 cr). Revenue from operations: ₹384.8 cr (+6.2% vs ₹362.4 cr). Growth promises are graded on revenue from operations; the grade is the same on either basis.
A Mainboard-migration promise of July 2024 is cited by an analyst on the May 2025 call. It originates in the unretrieved May 2024 call, so it is not graded at origin.
Q4 FY26 call: an analyst says FY26 guidance was cut to ₹400–420 cr on an earlier call. No source was opened for this [unverified].

promises.quote: We will continue to grow at 20% to 25% annually.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome_source: Q1 FY27 results release, NSE, 20 Jul 2026
promises.note: Management says guidance now includes Nivian. Vision 2030 target is ₹850–900 cr by FY30. Early read: Q1 FY27 revenue from operations ₹125.55 cr, +25.3% YoY (includes Nivian). Full year pending.

promises.quote: EBITDA margin will definitely come up above 23%, 24%
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.note: Early read: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 23.06% incl. other income, 21.80% excl. Full year pending.

promises.quote: at least 50% growth this year from exports ... between INR105 and INR110 [crore]
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome_source: Q1 FY27 results release, 20 Jul 2026; Q4 FY26 transcript (Q1 FY26 base)
promises.note: Transcript wording is garbled; this is a near-quote. Management also expects +30% in H1 FY27, which needs ≥₹56 cr against a ₹43 cr base. Early read: Q1 FY27 exports ₹17.2 cr vs ₹32.26 cr in Q1 FY26. Full year pending.

promises.quote: this quarter we will be closing more than INR20 crores. INR20 crores to INR22 crores
promises.speaker: Ashutosh Shukla, Director Sales & Marketing
promises.outcome: Q1 FY27 exports ₹17.2 cr, 14% below the ₹20 cr floor.
promises.outcome_source: Q1 FY27 results release, NSE, 20 Jul 2026
promises.note: Release says exports should accelerate for the rest of FY27.

promises.quote: EU audit which is scheduled in September first week of this year
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.note: Delay explained as a new EU rule requiring dossiers to be filed before inspection. Early read: Not retrieved. September 2026 has passed; no filing or news confirming the audit was found.

promises.quote: we will continue to grow at 20% to 25% ... we will be having strong numbers for the next half of the year
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY26 revenue from operations ₹384.8 cr vs ₹362.4 cr (+6.2%). Company headline total revenue ₹396.0 cr (+7.4%).
promises.outcome_source: Q1 FY27 results filing (FY26 column); FY26 results release 14 May 2026; Annual Report FY26
promises.note: Management disowned a ₹450 cr FY26 figure on this call; analysts attribute it to the May 2025 presentation. H1 FY26 growth was 13%.

promises.quote: EBITDA margins will remain between 23% and 25%.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY26 EBITDA margin 22.57% incl. other income, 0.43pp below the 23% floor.
promises.note: Excluding other income the margin was 19.67% (CFO, May 2026 call). The 23–25% figures were stated on an incl.-other-income basis.

promises.quote: if we did Rs.43 crores, we will be crossing Rs.100 crores of top line in exports for next half
promises.speaker: Management (answer to Pritesh)
promises.outcome: FY26 exports ₹71 cr, so H2 was about ₹28 cr.
promises.note: Tender awards slipped to March 2026. Management put the revenue impact at ₹20–25 cr, which still leaves H2 well short of ₹100 cr.

promises.quote: The Europe approval has been delayed for long, but finally it will happen in the first quarter of next year
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Audit not held. Rescheduled to September 2026 after a new rule required dossiers to be filed first.
promises.note: Reason was given only after the miss.

promises.quote: In the next six to eight months, our target is that we will be building up this facility and making our own intermediates.
promises.speaker: Management (answer to Punit Mittal)
promises.outcome: Annual Report FY26 (Sep 2026) says the facility is expected to be operational by end of Q3 FY27, about 5 months past the window.
promises.note: No reason stated in the documents opened. May 2026 call says 'commercialized by this year'.

promises.quote: borrowings are still the same, which will be converted next year June
promises.speaker: Nipun Arora, CFO
promises.outcome: CCDs converted in May 2026 at ₹1,643 per share.
promises.outcome_source: Q1 FY27 results release, 20 Jul 2026; Q4 FY26 transcript

promises.quote: next year we tend to increase at the same pace and that is 25% only.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY26 revenue from operations +6.2% (₹384.8 cr vs ₹362.4 cr).
promises.outcome_source: Q1 FY27 results filing (FY26 column); Annual Report FY26
promises.note: Same call also said sales would double in 3 years and gave ₹750-odd cr projections to FY28.

promises.quote: margins will be between 23% to 25% consolidated.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY26 EBITDA margin 22.57% incl. other income.
promises.note: 0.43pp below the 23% floor.

promises.quote: this division in the next half year, in September, we might be having some profit from our Cosmetology division
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Derma generated positive EBITDA of ₹11.32 lakh in H1 FY26.

promises.quote: in the next two, three months, we'll be migrating to the Mainboard for sure.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: NSE gave principal approval on 7 Nov 2025, with migration within ~10 days. Exact migration date not retrieved.
promises.note: No reason given for the slip. An analyst cited an earlier July 2024 promise on the same call, so the cumulative delay is about 16 months.

promises.quote: CDMO ... the growth will be expected between 5% to 10% only.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY26 CDMO ₹149 cr vs ₹148 cr (+1%).
promises.note: Management blames Platin non-supply, a reason disclosed after the fact.

promises.quote: our own branded business will keep on going at 23% to 30%
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Branded oncology ₹123 cr vs ₹103 cr (+19.4%; management says 20%).
promises.note: About 3.6pp below the floor.

promises.quote: There are two more NDDS, which we will be launching in this financial year.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Management says two new NDDS were launched in FY26 plus five new products.
promises.note: Methotrexate oral solution launched Apr 2026 after NPPA pricing. The two FY26 launches are not individually named in the call.

promises.quote: We are expecting the audit to come between October and December this year only.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: EU audit not held; moved to Jan–Mar 2026, then Sep 2026.
promises.outcome_source: H1 FY26 and Q4 FY26 transcripts
promises.note: The EU audit date has been reset on every call since May 2023.

promises.quote: We tend to grow at 25% to 30%.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY25 +24.1%, FY26 +6.2%. Two-year CAGR from FY24 ₹297 cr to FY26 ₹384.8 cr is about 13.8%.
promises.outcome_source: H2 FY25 transcript; Q1 FY27 results filing (FY26 column)

promises.quote: we expect around 50% growth on the export business for coming 3 years to 4 years
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY25 exports ₹80 cr (+73%), FY26 ₹71 cr (-11%). Two-year CAGR is about 24%.
promises.outcome_source: H2 FY25 and Q4 FY26 transcripts
promises.note: Years FY27–FY28 are still open.

promises.quote: the total capex will be from the internal accruals ... not be more than INR10 crores to INR12 crores.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Management says it invested about ₹45 cr across the three plants in FY26, incl. land and the intermediate plant. Annual Report says ₹10.45 cr was invested in the API facility.
promises.outcome_source: Q4 FY26 transcript, p9; Annual Report FY26
promises.note: The promise excluded 'new things which we have planned', and the split cannot be verified from the documents opened.

promises.quote: on overall basis, we expect a growth of 7% to 10% here
promises.speaker: Management (unnamed), on CDMO
promises.outcome: FY25 CDMO ₹148 cr vs ₹140 cr (+5.7%).
promises.note: 1.3pp below the floor.

promises.quote: The COFEPRIS audit is expected by Jan
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Mexico audit took place in March 2025, about 2 months late.
promises.note: No reason given for the slip.

promises.quote: EU-GMP audit is expected before March '25
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Not held; reset to Oct–Dec 2025 on the May 2025 call.

promises.quote: next financial year, we are expecting around close to INR26 to INR30 CR with launch of new molecules.
promises.speaker: Ashutosh Shukla, Director Sales & Marketing
promises.outcome: FY26 Derma sales ₹16.58 cr.
promises.note: Target was cut to ₹18–20 cr on the May 2025 call with no stated reason, and was still missed.

promises.quote: by the end of this year we want to make it at least 1,300 to 1,400.
promises.speaker: Ashutosh Shukla, Director Sales & Marketing
promises.outcome: Prescriber base grew from 1,200 to 2,600.

promises.quote: registrations are expected to be out by December end.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: May 2025 call says registrations came 'last month' (Apr 2025), about 4 months late.

promises.quote: we are combining this R&D and we are making one R&D center where we are doing a capex of close to INR10 crores to INR15 crores
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: Plan dropped. A building adjacent to the existing office was taken instead, and the land bought is to be sold.

promises.quote: Second will be launched in the month of January, February next year in 2025
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD

quarters.label: H2 FY24
quarters.note: Call listed on Trendlyne (15 May 2024) and Screener. Transcript not opened after 2 attempts.

quarters.label: H1 FY24

promises.quote: It will range between 25%-30% in the coming three years.

promises.quote: we have got the deadline from the EU from between October to February next year.
promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: EU audit not held as of the May 2026 call. Dates reset in Nov 2024, May 2025, Nov 2025 and May 2026.

promises.quote: three molecules or four molecules will be launched by this year end.

promises.outcome: One NDDS launched in Jan 2024. A second was due Jan–Feb 2025.

promises.speaker: Rahul Batra, Chairman & MD
promises.outcome: FY23 revenue ₹227 cr, 1.3% below the floor.
